output.headline: UPMC is the Healthcare Services specialist: all three prior deals in the target's own sub-sector, all closed, with $15M-$25M synergy headroom.
output.differentiator: Every deal sits in the target's own sub-sector and all closed (3 of 3), a clean record matching Advocate Health; its 11.7x median paid is the lowest on the priority list. [T:record, K:closed_share]
output.why_them: Strategic buyer with a pure own-sub-sector deal record

acquirer_overview.title: A $27.7 billion strategic with a focused, fully closed deal record
points: Strategic buyer in Healthcare Services with revenue of US$27.7 billion (2023). [P:1]
Hospitals in Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York; Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024. [P:2]
Three control deals from 2018 to 2020, all closed; median deal $55M. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Own-sub-sector focus makes the target a natural fit
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor for UPMC; target margin fit is a strong factor. [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit]
Platform Build in 1 of 3 deals and Cross-sell in 1 of 3 (21% of all deals in file) point to add-on and revenue logic. [M:platform_build, M:cross_sell]
Likelihood of 4.7%, third on the priority list of 10 and fourth overall. [R:rank]

precedent_activity.title: Three same-sub-sector deals, none yet in the Midwest
points: Principal Behavioral Health: $444M bolt-on acquisition, 2019, 11.7x EBITDA. [D:MA-2019-0090]
Sterling Care Network: $55M strategic acquisition, 2020, 11.3x. Keystone Behavioral Health: $33M recapitalization, 2018, 17.0x. [D:MA-2020-0312, D:MA-2018-0486]

valuation_context.title: Defend the 75th percentile; UPMC's own history sits lower
points: Comparable deals run 10.7x to 15.3x (median 12.8x); the target's 16.8% margin against a 12.9% comps median supports the 75th percentile. [V:comps]
UPMC's median paid is 11.7x, below the comparable median, though Keystone reached 17.0x. [V:comps, D:MA-2018-0486]
Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M (cost synergies, half realised) and US$27.7 billion revenue support the ability to pay. [V:synergy]

risk_flags.title: Price gap
risk_flags.concern: Median paid of 11.7x trails the 75th percentile of 15.3x. [V:comps]
risk_flags.mitigant: Margin above 87% of comps supports upper-quartile pricing; Keystone paid 17.0x. [V:comps, D:MA-2018-0486]
risk_flags.reality: Expect UPMC to anchor near the 12.8x median. [V:comps]

risk_flags.title: No Midwest or size-band record
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region and 0 of 3 in the $100M-$400M band. [T:record, K:size_band]
risk_flags.mitigant: The $444M Principal Behavioral Health bolt-on shows it can write a larger cheque. [D:MA-2019-0090]
risk_flags.reality: Footprint is Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York; the Midwest would be new. [P:2]

risk_flags.title: Quiet since 2020
risk_flags.concern: No deals since 2022; the last was in 2020. [K:recent, T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024, showing continued expansion. [P:2]
risk_flags.reality: Recent activity is only a slight factor against. [S:recency]

conviction.rationale: 3 deals in the target's own sub-sector and none adjacent, and third among the highest-scored buyers after review; the absence of a deal in the target's region is neutral. [C:conviction]
